name: sevm-node-shims
description: JS-first Node.js shim layer for the MochiBerry engine (SEVM stack).

modules.name: mochinode
modules.description: Core loader: require(), loadNative(), resolvePackage, BUILTIN_ALIASES passthrough

modules.name: mochiglobals
modules.description: Installs missing globals: setTimeout/setInterval/clear*, URL, TextEncoder/Decoder, AbortController, structuredClone, fetch, crypto

modules.name: mochitimers
modules.description: Node timers over mbjs:os, also installed as globals

modules.name: mochicrypto
modules.description: node:crypto shim: createHash/createHmac/pbkdf2/Cipheriv/randomBytes over mochicrypto.dll

modules.name: mochizlib
modules.description: node:zlib shim: gzip/gunzip/inflateRaw/deflateRaw/crc32 + transforms over mochizlib.dll (native framing verified vs Python)

modules.name: mochifs
modules.description: node:fs shim over mochifs.dll with mbjs:std fallback

modules.name: mochibuffer
modules.description: node:buffer shim (MochiBuffer extends Uint8Array), installs globalThis.Buffer

modules.name: mochievents
modules.description: node:events shim: EventEmitter

modules.name: mochipath
modules.description: node:path shim: join/resolve/dirname/basename/normalize

modules.name: mochiutil
modules.description: node:util shim: format/inspect/promisify

modules.name: mochistream
modules.description: node:stream shim: Readable/Writable/Transform

modules.name: mochiurl
modules.description: node:url shim: URL/URLSearchParams (+ SimpleURL fallback)

modules.name: mochios
modules.description: node:os shim: platform/arch/tmpdir/homedir/cpus/freemem/totalmem (totalmem/freemem real from mbjs:os.memoryInfo; cpus empty — no per-CPU source)

modules.name: mochiprocess
modules.description: node:process shim: env/argv/arch/hrtime/uptime + globalThis.process; memoryUsage real (mbjs:os.memoryInfo), pid real (dynalib GetCurrentProcessId); cpuUsage zero (no engine CPU-time source)

modules.name: mochimodule
modules.description: node:module shim: createRequire()

modules.name: mochisandbox
modules.description: Realm-isolated sandbox: create/run/runAsync/clone/free/count/setGlobal, per-realm intrinsics, memLimit/budgetMs; SECURITY.md

modules.name: mochiws
modules.description: node:ws / WebSocket shim + httpGet/httpRequest over mochiws.dll (WinHTTP): GET verified; httpRequest(method,url,body,ct) enables POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE + payload

modules.name: mochihttp
modules.description: node:http shim: ClientRequest/IncomingMessage; get() over httpGet, request() over httpRequest — POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE with body verified (201, body echoed)

modules.name: mochihttps
modules.description: node:https shim: request()/get() delegated to mochihttp (POST/PUT/PATCH inherited)

modules.name: mochiasync_hooks
modules.description: node:async_hooks shim: AsyncLocalStorage (single-context, non-async-correct)

modules.name: mochitls
modules.description: node:tls shim: real Schannel TLS client — TLSSocket.connect over mochitls.dll (full chain + hostname validation, TLS 1.2/1.3); createServer unsupported

modules.name: mochinet
modules.description: node:net shim: Socket.createConnection/connect over mochinode_net.tcpConnect (real client TCP: connect/write/end + 'data' poll loop); createServer still MOCHI_UNSUPPORTED (HTTP server in node_modules/net)

modules.name: mochidiagnostics_channel
modules.description: node:diagnostics_channel shim: no-op channel()

modules.name: mochiperf_hooks
modules.description: node:perf_hooks shim: performance passthrough + no-op PerformanceObserver

modules.name: mochiworker_threads
modules.description: node:worker_threads shim: real Worker over mbjs:os.Worker (new runtime+context + message pipe) — round trip verified (10! = 3628800); isMainThread/parentPort detected, not hardcoded; no terminate handle, threadId null, workerData not delivered

modules.name: mochijsnative
modules.description: AOT/JIT + WASM native bridge (eval/jit*/runtime*/value*/context*, hostBase/hostExport/lastError) — 51 exports verified

modules.name: mochijsnative_stub
modules.description: fallback for mochijsnative when native unavailable

modules.name: dynalib
modules.description: JS API for libdynalib (dynalib(file, offset, symbol, abi, opts))

modules.name: events
modules.description: stand-in node:events for the express/net stack

modules.name: express
modules.description: Express-compatible router: middleware chain, path params, query, json/urlencoded/text body, static + traversal guard, res helpers, template engines (mini-EJS), vhost, app.param, error middleware

modules.name: fs
modules.description: node:fs entry re-exported from mochifs

modules.name: net
modules.description: node:net entry over mochinode_net.dll

modules.name: sqlite
modules.description: node:sqlite-style shim over mochinode_sqlite.dll (bind parameters not wired)
